name: Cohance Lifesciences Ltd
title: Cohance Lifesciences Ltd - 543064 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: FY26 revenue fell about 13% to INR22.68bn on destocking and the Nacharam disruption; management calls Q1 FY27 the low point with recovery only from H2, and gives no numeric FY27 guidance.

utilisation.quote: While utilization levels are still normalizing, customer engagement and order visibility have steadily improved.

capex.quote: We expect capex spend of nearly INR 3 billion in FY27.

triggers.label: Q1 FY27 low on revenue and EBITDA
triggers.quote: Quarter 1 FY27 is to be low on both revenue and EBITDA

triggers.label: Middle East cost inflation 100-150 bps GM hit
triggers.quote: Q1 will experience impact of nearly 100 to 150 bps on our FY26 gross margin levels

triggers.label: Capex rises to ~INR3bn in FY27
triggers.quote: We expect capex spend of nearly INR 3 billion in FY27.

guidance.quote: Quarter 1 FY27 is to be low on both revenue and EBITDA
quarter 2 would be stable while quarter 1 is a weak quarter both on revenue and EBITDA
the growth would be on a year -on-year basis
We expect capex spend of nearly INR 3 billion in FY27.
